items.subject: Security alert
items.summary: Google sent a second new-sign-in alert for a Windows device later the same day, separate from the earlier Windows sign-in notification.
items.action: Confirm whether you made both Windows sign-ins. If either is unfamiliar, open Google Account security directly, review recent activity, secure the account and sign out unfamiliar sessions.
items.decisionNeeded: Whether the second Windows sign-in was yours.
